notes.id: Uang pangkal Rp49.470.000 (putra) / Rp49.870.000 (putri). Data TA 2024/2025 dari survei pribadi orang tua (unggahan Instagram) yang dikutip media; uang pangkal umumnya sudah termasuk seragam, buku, dan fasilitas. Konfirmasi ke sekolah.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp49,470,000 (boys) / Rp49,870,000 (girls). 2024/2025 figures from a parent's own survey (Instagram post) quoted by the outlet; entry fees usually include uniforms, books and facilities. Confirm with the school.
